from pathlib import Path
KAGGLE_WORKING_ROOT = Path('/kaggle/working').resolve()
KAGGLE_TEMP_ROOT = Path('/kaggle/temp').resolve()
WAN2GP_ROOT = (KAGGLE_WORKING_ROOT / 'Wan2GP').resolve()
WAN_SESSION_DATA_ROOT = (KAGGLE_TEMP_ROOT / 'Wan2GP-data').resolve()
WAN_OUTPUTS_DIR = (KAGGLE_WORKING_ROOT / 'Wan2GP-outputs').resolve()
WAN_CKPTS_DIR = (WAN_SESSION_DATA_ROOT / 'ckpts').resolve()
WAN_LORAS_DIR = (WAN_SESSION_DATA_ROOT / 'loras').resolve()
WAN_CACHE_DIR = (WAN_SESSION_DATA_ROOT / 'cache').resolve()
WAN2GP_ROOT.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
WAN_SESSION_DATA_ROOT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
WAN_CKPTS_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
WAN_LORAS_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
WAN_OUTPUTS_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
WAN_CACHE_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

import os, shutil, subprocess
env = os.environ.copy()
env['DEBIAN_FRONTEND'] = 'noninteractive'
apt_prefix = [] if os.geteuid() == 0 else ['sudo'] if shutil.which('sudo') else []
subprocess.run(apt_prefix + ['apt-get', 'update', '-qq'], check=True, env=env)
subprocess.run([*apt_prefix, 'apt-get', 'install', '-y', '--no-install-recommends', 'ffmpeg', 'libglib2.0-0', 'libgl1', 'libportaudio2'], check=True, env=env)

import importlib, os, subprocess, sys
env = os.environ.copy()
env['PIP_NO_CACHE_DIR'] = '1'
env['PIP_CACHE_DIR'] = str(WAN_CACHE_DIR / 'pip')
env['HF_HOME'] = str(WAN_CACHE_DIR / 'huggingface')
env['HUGGINGFACE_HUB_CACHE'] = str(WAN_CACHE_DIR / 'huggingface' / 'hub')
env['TRANSFORMERS_CACHE'] = str(WAN_CACHE_DIR / 'huggingface' / 'transformers')
env['TORCH_HOME'] = str(WAN_CACHE_DIR / 'torch')
env['XDG_CACHE_HOME'] = str(WAN_CACHE_DIR / '.cache')
import torch
if not torch.cuda.is_available():
    raise RuntimeError('CUDA not available')
constraints = WAN_CACHE_DIR / 'kaggle-torch-constraints.txt'
constraint_lines = [f'torch=={torch.__version__.split("+", 1)[0]}']
for name in ('torchvision', 'torchaudio'):
    try:
        module = importlib.import_module(name)
        constraint_lines.append(f'{name}=={module.__version__.split("+", 1)[0]}')
    except Exception:
        pass
constraints.write_text('\n'.join(constraint_lines) + '\n')
subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-m', 'pip', 'install', '--no-cache-dir', '--upgrade', 'setuptools', 'wheel'], check=True, env=env)
subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-m', 'pip', 'install', '--no-cache-dir', '--upgrade-strategy', 'only-if-needed', '-r', str(WAN2GP_ROOT / 'requirements.txt'), '-c', str(constraints)], check=True, env=env)

from pathlib import Path
target = WAN2GP_ROOT / 'preprocessing/matanyone/tools/interact_tools.py'
needle = "matplotlib.use('TkAgg')"
replacement = "matplotlib.use('Agg')"
if target.exists() and needle in target.read_text():
    target.write_text(target.read_text().replace(needle, replacement, 1))

from pathlib import Path
target = WAN2GP_ROOT / 'wgp.py'
text = target.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
replacements = {'advanced = server_config.get("last_advanced_choice", False)': 'advanced = False', 'with gr.Row(visible= True): #len(loras)>0) as presets_column:': 'with gr.Row(visible=False):', 'model_description = gr.HTML(description_html, visible= True)': 'model_description = gr.HTML(description_html, visible=False)', 'header = gr.Markdown(header_html, visible= True)': 'header = gr.Markdown(header_html, visible=False)', 'with gr.Row(visible=not audio_only) as resolution_row:': 'with gr.Row(visible=False) as resolution_row:', 'with gr.Row(visible = not lock_inference_steps) as inference_steps_row:': 'with gr.Row(visible=False) as inference_steps_row:', 'show_advanced = gr.Checkbox(label="Advanced Mode", value=advanced_ui)': 'show_advanced = gr.Checkbox(label="Advanced Mode", value=False, visible=False)', 'with gr.Tabs(visible=advanced_ui) as advanced_row:': 'with gr.Tabs(visible=False) as advanced_row:', 'with gr.Column(visible= not edit_mode):': 'with gr.Column(visible=False):', 'with gr.Accordion("Media Info / Late Post Processing / Import Media", open=False) as video_info_accordion:': 'with gr.Accordion("Media tools", open=False, visible=False) as video_info_accordion:', 'get_max_frames(737 if test_any_sliding_window(base_model_type) else 337), value=current_video_length,': 'min(get_max_frames(737 if test_any_sliding_window(base_model_type) else 337), 121), value=min(current_video_length, 121),'}
changed = 0
for old, new in replacements.items():
    if old in text:
        text = text.replace(old, new, 1)
        changed += 1
target.write_text(text, encoding='utf-8')
print(f'Simplified UI patch applied: {changed}/{len(replacements)} changes')

import os, subprocess, sys
env = os.environ.copy()
env['WAN_CACHE_DIR'] = str(WAN_CACHE_DIR)
env['HF_HOME'] = str(WAN_CACHE_DIR / 'huggingface')
env['HUGGINGFACE_HUB_CACHE'] = str(WAN_CACHE_DIR / 'huggingface' / 'hub')
env['TRANSFORMERS_CACHE'] = str(WAN_CACHE_DIR / 'huggingface' / 'transformers')
env['TORCH_HOME'] = str(WAN_CACHE_DIR / 'torch')
env['XDG_CACHE_HOME'] = str(WAN_CACHE_DIR / '.cache')
cmd = [sys.executable, '-u', 'wgp.py', '--listen', '--server-port', '7860', '--share', '--profile', '5']
process = subprocess.Popen(cmd, cwd=str(WAN2GP_ROOT), env=env, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, text=True, bufsize=1)
for line in iter(process.stdout.readline, ''):
    if not line:
        break
    print(line, end='')
